item.description: phosphene.xyz will now be used to host software releases, complete with checksums and signatures always. Find ALL releases here Software Short Description Link Watercraft Linux 0.1.0 A Linux disto built from Devuan Excalibur (Debian without systemd). Ships with bash scripts that make configuring a system for Development or Entertainment on Linux a lot easier. Earliest development stages still so volunteer contributors are welcomed and user patience is appreciated. Watercraft 0.1.0 Ketch
